meta.title: Improve group by compilation
meta.body_summary: Optimize VM group-by compilation to avoid extra index lookups and update IR golden files accordingly.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex optimized VM group-by compilation and updated IR golden files; merged in 16 seconds with no review or performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1795 changed lines across 9 files, this is a medium-sized change by absolute volume, but most churn (1700+ lines) is in IR golden file updates for 8 group-by test cases; the core VM optimization in runtime/vm/vm.go is only 53 lines. It fits a small compiler optimization that updates many test expectations and was self-merged quickly.

review_details.performance_claim: Optimize VM group-by compilation to avoid extra index lookups.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: AI generated a compiler optimization with expected IR changes; maintainer merged rapidly without independent review or performance validation, illustrating a low-friction process boundary for trusted contributors.

core_change_summary.description: In runtime/vm/vm.go, refactored group-by compilation logic to eliminate redundant index lookups, with corresponding updates to 8 IR golden test files (group_by*.ir.out) to reflect the new generated code.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: These IR golden file updates represent the bulk of line changes and serve as automated correctness tests for the compiler optimization.
